name: Spirit of the Latch
source:
East Coast U.S.A. in 1900 C.E.

Edmund Harrt is looking for "the corpsetalker", a government-sponsored sorcerer rumored to have past connections to Edmund's late employer. Edmund thinks he has little to offer in exchange, but he's curious. Will the simple act of appealing for help bring peace to a kind woman's family?

Ash Simmons is a man who excels at getting himself into extraordinary trouble. He is better known for helping people understand the problems they got into themselves. When a delightfully nosy and surprisingly disarming stranger shows up to reconnect him to old friends, he has a blast doing both in own unique way.

How will their first eventful evening together end?
